title: Global Temperatures Hit Record Highs Amid Clean Energy Grid Push

description: Global mean temperatures continue rising past key stability targets. Industrial sectors split between aggressive carbon capture and clean grid acceleration.

description: AI model inference and training clusters consume growing percentages of power grids, accelerating utility investments in nuclear and renewable infrastructure.
